regime_context: TSX shows broad rotation with Big Banks as the leading eligible theme (full breadth, moderate durability, but crowded). Base Metals is the main challenger but with zero breadth, signaling narrow momentum. Absolute-trend gate validated for risk control; several sectors remain ineligible (Tech, Telecom, Gold, Silver, Uranium). The macro backdrop features AI/tech, geopolitics, and high unscheduled surprise share, adding uncertainty. No strong one-narrative structure.
emerging_watch: Watch Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) if its theme breadth (currently 0.0) rises for 5 consecutive days; that would indicate growing constituent participation and could signal a durable challenge to the Banks' leadership. This would retire the watch.

The mean-reverting tendency in the broader market (gate_helps true) supports avoiding non-trending segments.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes above its 200-day simple moving average and holds above for 10 consecutive trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
